{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Final confirmation: load data, clean, and compute mean age of converted customers with valid age
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue column
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for converted customers with valid age (not -1)
converted_valid_age = sales_df[(sales_df['converted'] == 1) & (sales_df['customer_age'] != -1)]

# Compute the mean age
mean_age = converted_valid_age['customer_age'].mean()

# Round to two decimal places
mean_age_rounded = round(mean_age, 2)

mean_age_rounded"}
